voice.name: Cyril - French-Accented Narrator
voice.why: Hugo Valmy is a go-between in a dark suit and a flat cap: smooth, wary and French. Cyril is a confident middle-aged French-accented voice, level and a little amused, a long way from Marcel's gravel, Gaspard's rasp and the night-shift worker's weariness.

greet.text: Hugo Valmy. I help people who have more than they need meet people who need more than they have. Sit if you like, the coffee is honest, but I do not talk business with a face I do not know.

sell.text: So you opened the red crate. If you still have what was in it, I know a buyer: cash on the spot, no questions. He keeps to the lanes and the quay after dark. The police will only thank you.

sold.text: Then we have never met, and you have never seen the red crate. A pleasure doing no business with you.

threat.text: You walked it to the desk. Fine. Mind the coast road at night, friend. It is long, and it is short of lamps.

replies.reported: I took what was in the crate to the police.
replies.sold: I found a buyer for what was in the crate.
replies.crate: I opened the red crate on the quay.
